question: In which of the following devices are eddy currents utilised beneficially?
solution:
The correct answer is __Induction furnaces**(option 4)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Induction furnaces__ utilise eddy currents for heating materials.
 
• Eddy currents are generated by electromagnetic induction when a conducting material is placed in a varying magnetic field.
 
• These currents create heat due to the resistance of the material, making it an efficient method for melting metals and alloys.
 
• Induction furnaces are widely used in industrial processes for melting, refining, and alloying metals.
 
• They are energy-efficient and provide precise control over the temperature.
 
• Unlike traditional furnaces, they do not require fuel combustion, making them environmentally friendly.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Electric heaters:**
 
 
• These use resistance heating elements to convert electricity into heat, not eddy currents.
 
 
 
• **Electric motors:**
 
 
• While eddy currents can occur in motors, they are generally considered undesirable as they cause energy losses and heating.
 
 
 
• **Transformer cores:**
 
 
• Eddy currents are minimised in transformer cores by using laminated sheets to reduce energy losses.
